review: Beware of the cheap plastic handle to raise the foot support breaking into pieces after year or so. DISGUSTING.

review: These remind me of the plastic me grandmother kept on her couch, permanently. Pass on these folks. They take up a lot of room and clearly you’re trying to organize?? Try ikea zip shoe bags. They’re very large for a shoe bag, 79. and take up only as much room as the item inside requires!
title: Meh.

review: This will not fit even the smallest recliner! Save your money! What a waste of money! A joke! It might fit a kitchen chair but no way will it fit a recliner!!!

review: This recliner is not good and it us not sturdy at all Definitely do not recommend this at all

review: This coffee table is horrible. I've had it for about a month, it is so wabbly you can't scoot it to move it when needed and I tried to pick it up to move it yesterday, the to came off. Ive had it alligator to long past the warranty and can't get a refund. I don't know how to get ahold of seller to see if he'll replace it already with a different model that has thicker stronger legs.. Don't buy this cheap coffee table. The legs are so skinny there is no stability to it at all

review: This pillow is insanely huge. It is incredibly uncomfortable and not at all what I was expecting. It easily weighs 15 pounds. It’s not something you can take from your bedroom downstairs to your couch and even if you could you would have only inches of space on your couch to sit down because this thing is so gigantic. The neck roll pillow that it comes with is useless as well, it does not hold it’s shape and provides no support
title: Gigantic and useless

review: Since I am a full-sized person and not a Hobbit, this couch is too small for me. I am going to get some different legs for it to see if I can raise it up. The couch is one foot off the ground when assembled. It is absolutely ridiculous. It is also too narrow and too shallow. This was built maybe with the Japanese market in mind instead of the American market.
title: Great couch... for a Hobbit!!!

review: Not durable at all. Not waterproof at all. Tore in multiple places and the fabric wore out very quickly. Bought two and regret it. Did not protect my couch at all so it was a waste of money.
title: Unhappy!

review: Got it to protect my sofa while potty training. Yeah, this things isn't water proof at all.
title: Not water resistant or proof or anything.

review: Worst couch ever. Hardware doesn’t fit and the seat backs are not stable.
title: Do. Not. Buy.

review: I should of looked at the dimensions. Totally my fault though, I should've paid attention. Too small for a bedside table.
title: I should of looked at the dimensions. Totally my ...

review: I hate this chair!!! The right arm was split several inches, it's too short for a recliner, and what recliner has a plastic pole that unzips from the back of the chair to hold it in a reclining position!!!!! I would have returned it, but the box was HUGE and too heavy, and bulky for me to try to send back. It'll donate to Salvation Army. Very disappointed. Cannot believe the good reviews it got!!!!
title: I HATE this chair!!!

review: After 2 month, I don't know how the sofa hurts everywhere. I had a body pain for a month then I realized it's the sofa. There are few points where it hurts to even sit. I side rests became loose. I just hate it.
title: Want to hurt your back? Go for it!

review:
Remember going to visit a girlfriend in college and her dad made you sleep on the dresser pull out sofa? And that bar that cut right across your spine and left you in pain after attempting to toss and turn for 8 hours only to leave you crippled for two days after?
Yeah, that's what sitting in this chair feels like after 15 minutes.
Avoid buying this
On the positive side , my dog loves the box it came in
title: Torture device

review: I usually try to read descriptions prior to purchase. It cuts down on the disappointment. In this case however the descriptors were misleading. This is NOT a good Ottoman. Not even a good pouf. It doesn't hold its shape well at all. My cat uses it now as her imprint is permanently imprinted on it. Oh well. You get what you pay for.
title: If only the picture shown was honest

review: Holy cats are these useless pillows. Yea, I knew they were down but I figured they'd be soft enough to use on my bed. Nope. The cotton is very heavy which makes arranging the pillow to where you want it darn near impossible. I thought ok, I'd use them for couch pillows. IMPOSSIBLE! You go to sit down and lean on them and the feathers poke thru making it very difficult to get comfy. I'd send them back but a) I won't go in to any store to return right now due to Covid & b) it'd cost too much to make it worth while to have UPS pick them up. Guess I'm just stuck with them.
title: Not even for my couch

review: Super cheap. Poorly sewn. Very thin fabric. I wanted to protect the leather on my ottoman, but this is so ugly and ill fitting I don't know if I'll even use it until I find something else. I'm annoyed that I paid twenty bucks for this trash.
title: Cheap

review: looks great on the bed. I don't really understand not having a fitted sheet and having a flat sheet instead. Even the flat sheet is not made for a bed, looks like its made for a futon too. It looks like it was made for a futon instead of a bed. With no fitted sheet, I've had to go out and buy fitted sheets to go with this.
title: NO FITTED SHEET, MADE FOR A FUTON, NOT A BED.

review: It was very pretty and fit well, but, on,our leather couch it kept sliding off the back as it was being used. Also it kept shifting with use.
title: It slides off

review: I eat on the couch in front of the TV and instead of using a towel I figured it's a good idea to use an adult bib. LOL Hey why not? It's not just for Lobster. This is a prime order. I ordered it on the 1st. It arrived on the fifth. Not good. First wash, the color ran.
title: Not the best.

review: Really wished this was the ONE.... but it turn out to be a mess of clumps. Its ok for a couch pillow though...rather overpriced at that.

review: I got this for when I was staying over with a friend after she fell and needed care 24 -7. Was sleeping on her couch and thought this would be better.. I was wrong and sent it back.
title: Not for everyone

review:
Some of the holes were not carved deep enough to fit the nails that were supposed to go into them. Because of this, we couldn’t install the doors. I asked for a new bottom piece to be sent out, but it’s seeming like they’re asking me to send the whole thing back. Not worth disassembling the entire thing when all I need is one new bottom piece.

Either way, we decided to keep it up without the doors although it would be nice to have them. It’s a great size for an apartment or small space since it isn’t very big.
title: Small Space TV Stand

review: I was pleased at how it fit and looked when I put it on my outside table. No need to worry about it blowing around in the wind. However, it faded quickly. I recommend a print if your table is in the sun
title: Faded fast

review: This fan is nice to have when you're electricity goes out Because it's rechargeable. It doesn't blow very hard or very far so I put it on the coffee table in front of me. At 1st I used the oscillating motion but It took my battery down very fast. I recharged it and next time I used it I just kept it on straight In it lasted a good 9 to hours when are electricity went out. I was able to stay cool until I fell asleep.
title: Ok...

review:
The ottoman is okay. I like that is foldable and can be stored if I am traveling in an RV but it is not very sturdy. I would not ever let anyone sit on it. You can put your legs on it and my 28lb dog climbs on it with no issues but it would need to be made with stronger wood if you wanted children to sit on it.

Other than that it is great for storage.

Oh the packaging it came it came sucked.
title: Works for my needs.

review: There is nothing to dislike about this pillow. I need it at night to support my neck because I sleep in a recliner. The hand pump is great for me because I have tremors from Parkinson’s and blowing up a pillow and then getting the cap on before it deflates is difficult. I don’t know what the fabric is but it is the only travel pillow I’ve used that doesn’t make my neck sweaty.
title: It’s very easy to inflate, but it doesn’t stay inflated all night

review:
This was easy putting it together.
It’s supposed to look like a type of fire pit, but it is too small.
It fits on our outdoor low coffee table between rod-iron furniture or on the ground in
The garden.
Mine came with a crooked light inside, although packaged very good, and does not flicker like my Other type of torches do.
It flashes on and off, not like the dancing looking flames, and it is more yellow then red.
title: Mine is crooked, flame is more yellow then red!

review: Nothing like a down pillow. Feels like a cheap overstuffed Walmart pillow. They hold their shape so they look good on my couch but they aren't very comfy. Came in a clear plastic bag in a large box -no vacuum packaging. Disappointed that they aren't really "down alternative" but you get what you pay for I guess!
title: Not down alternative at all

review: I ordered this to set on my console table for keys. I had looked at the measurements when I ordered it, but it seems so much smaller. It will work for what I got it for, I’m just not sure it’s worth what I paid.

review: The blue is slightly darker/paler than I'd like, but still a nice blue. The gray and blue go well with our beige couch. The fabric definitely has that rougher, farmhouse feel, which is exactly what I wanted.
title: Not as blue as the pics, but still nice.

review: I wish these were a little sturdier. This is the third handle since I got my beloved recliner.

review: Got these because reviews were great & it was super easy to fit to our couch however we have 3 dogs & a cat... the fur is EVERYWHERE. It is almost impossible to vacuum out & doesn't come out in the wash either. Huge bummer but still giving 3 stars for the comfort & ease of install.
title: Soft & looks great but NOT easy to get fur off!

review:
The knob for the door is the highest quality piece, very heavy duty feel. Seriously.
The top and legs are solid pieces of wood, however the sides and back are panels, and feel cheap.
The door is also wood.
Overall it gets a 3 star because it there's some 1 star pieces and 5 star pieces on this night stand.
It was $40 so it did meet my expectation as that's not much for an end table

review: Meh. These are ok and they fit two pillows we already have on the sofa. The gold color is pretty brash and I don't want to look at it year round - perhaps during the Christmas holidays only. However, the texture on these cases is scratchy and rough. Definitely not meant for actually using as you sit.

review:
They are NOT like real leather
We are using for feet rest on coffee table and like that they can be cleaned so easily - wiped off quickly
They are rubbery however and SMALL

review: Very nicely made except for the legs, they aren't real wood. The futon is very firm. The color is a bright white. I haven't slept on it but will give an update on it when I do. It's ok for sitting. A few pillows and lounging on it is fairly comfortable. I would recommend this as a short term sofa/bed.

review: This is a sturdy coffee table. It looks nice in my daughter's new apartment. It was easy to put together. The size is good. For the price, it's definitely a bargain!

review: Overall, it was easy enough to assemble. There are a couple of parts that you need to really pay close attention to the directions because it is easy to get it backwards and require you taking it off and putting it back on correctly. The finished unit is sturdy. My daughter has this in her apartment as a TV stand. Her TV isn't very big, so she didn't need something over sized. The shelves work well for her video game consoles.
title: Works Great!

review: My daughter is moving into an unfurnished apartment this summer and was in need of furniture. This is a decent, neutral futon that kind of has a mid-century vibe to it. It's a beige color with a hint of sage green to it. It took my daughter and my husband about 30 minutes to put it together. The instructions were okay, but not great. The piece is sturdy and will be good for her apartment. She's excited that it turns into a bed for guests.
title: Sturdy

It does slide on the floor.

review: This is such a beautiful basket! It has a grey removable, washable liner that is so neutral that it will blend in with any decor. The basket is very light weight. I didnt use it in my kitchen because I have a dark wood side table with a bottom shelf in my living room. I put the basket down there and it looks wonderful. Im not sure what I will be putting in it, most likely will be books lol. Nice size too. Def.recommend this !

review: This is a very nice recliner. I love it! I'm giving it 5 stars because, it is perfect for me. I'm only 5 feet tall and this is the first recliner to fit me. My feet reach the ground perfectly, unlike other recliners. If you need a small recliner this one is comfortable, easy to assemble and is attractive! If you need something big, you need to keep searching.
title: Small recliner, looks great and it's comfortable.

review:
Super easy to install, and has given a new life and feel to our couches.

We used to have couches that would sag and hurt our backs, but now we feel like our couches have a couple more years of life in them.

They also help my in-laws to be able to get off of the couch where as before, they needed help to get up and off.
title: Does what it’s supposed to do

review: I have always gone all out when it comes to decorating for holidays and seasons. I saw these pumpkins and have to get them. They are a good size - actually a little larger than I anticipated. They're too large for my tiered tray, but great for the mantel or end table. I really like the burlap on the front. The texture of the burlap adds to the aesthetics.
title: Nice Looking Pumpkins

review: These are nice end tables. They were easy to assemble. Directions were easy to follow. The tables are pretty simple as far as design, but they are very stable and sturdy.
title: Nice Tables

review: This is a gorgeous TV stand. Instructions were pretty clear and easy to understand which made assembly straight forward. From start to finish, it took about half an hour to build it. The finished piece is sturdy and looks great! I am very pleased with it!

review: Everything it says it is! Went on so easy so will come off easy to clean.

review: Quick and easy to set up, and it looks fantastic, although I was hoping for more of the light blue to show in the fabric. It does, if the sun hits it, so all is well to accent my blue sofa. As a shortie, it's true, a small pillow is needed for comfort, but I'm used to that. Excellent product !!!!

review: Once set up, you'd never know this really is a FUTON ! It was simple to put together, and I actually thought I'd received a much smaller version it was so well packaged, no useful space neglected. Very quick and easy to assemble, though I did have to leave off one washer on a leg so it would settle correctly. I love this futon, it's very comfortable and pretty !!!

review: We are using these on medium sized recliners and they fit perfectly. The backs on our recliners are shortish, but they are long enough that they would fit on a taller recliner just as well. A bit wider than our recliner seats, but they tuck in easily and stay in place well. Neutral pattern looks great. They also wash and dry well. Would purchase again.
